clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, Sven Yorgen's grief still drives him to seek answers about his family's slaughter. A buried journal at the ruined farm may reveal who witnessed it.

Sven Yorgen returned to find his family dead and his farm in ruins after dark riders struck while he was away. Grief and vengeance drove him to send allies to search the wreckage of the homestead. Beneath a mound of freshly turned earth lay a small, dirt-stained book, hastily hidden by a shadowy figure.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Digging through the mound, you find a small, dirt-stained book.
The book has no title, but...it has information Sven would like to know.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You found what?? Please, let me see it...

clips.title: Completion
paras: That shadowy figure I saw was a witness to my family's death! There are questions I'd like to ask that man...if only I knew who he was!
